transaction.closing_time_zone_basis: Lenovo identifies October 30 in Hong Kong. Google reports October 29 without specifying the filing date time zone. The exact hour remains unverified.

license.amendment_summary: Section 6(a) amended the underlying agreement so all claims other than Schedule 2 were included in Licensed-Back Intellectual Property. Section 6(b) grants a separate license to GTH and its subsidiaries under all Schedule 2 claims after the reverse assignment.
license.licensed_back_to: Certain members of the Motorola Mobility Group, with parties further identified in the 2015 instrument.
license.scope: Excluded IP transferred by Motorola Mobility Group to Google Group before closing. The European Commission records broad licenses in relation to all retained Motorola Mobility patents. Google discloses a license for continued operations, with retained patents including pending applications and invention disclosures.
